quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to share kind words after a family meal"?
quests.question: Say Thank You for Dinner
quests.hint: This happens right after everyone finishes eating, not before.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say thank you for dinner to show we appreciate the meal.
quests.funFact: Saying thank you is a simple habit that can make the people around you feel appreciated!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to bring along a small treat for later in the day"?
quests.question: Pack a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a whole lunch, just a little extra.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack a snack in the morning for a little treat later on.
quests.funFact: A small packed snack can be just the boost you need in the middle of a busy day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to check for cars before crossing the street"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: You turn your head left, then right, for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We look both ways to check for cars before crossing the street.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing is one of the most important safety habits to learn!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to bundle up warm before stepping into chilly air"?
quests.question: Put on a Coat
quests.hint: This goes on over your shirt when it's cold outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on a coat to stay warm on a chilly day.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather first can help you know if you'll need a coat that day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to look outside and see if it's sunny or rainy"?
quests.question: Check the Weather
quests.hint: Clouds, sunshine, or rain are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We check the weather in the morning to plan what to wear.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather can help you decide between a raincoat or sunglasses!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to choose the time your morning will begin"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: A clock helps with this one, usually right before bed.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set an alarm at night to help us wake up on time.
quests.funFact: The very first alarm clocks were invented so people wouldn't oversleep for work!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to get ready for a gentle wake-up call tomorrow"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: This helps you wake up at just the right time tomorrow.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting an alarm means choosing the time we want to wake up.
quests.funFact: A gentle alarm sound can help you wake up feeling calm instead of startled!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to show appreciation once dinner is finished"?
quests.question: Say Thank You for Dinner
quests.hint: These kind words show you appreciate the meal someone made.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying thank you is a kind way to end a family meal.
quests.funFact: Families around the world have their own kind words to share after a meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to layer up before heading out on a cold day"?
quests.question: Put on a Coat
quests.hint: Zippers or buttons help keep this snug and warm.
quests.explanation: That's right! Putting on a coat means adding a warm layer before going outside.
quests.funFact: Layering up with a coat traps warm air close to your body!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to find out if you'll need a coat or an umbrella"?
quests.question: Check the Weather
quests.hint: This helps you decide what to wear before you get dressed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Checking the weather helps us know if we need a coat or umbrella.
quests.funFact: Weather can change from sunny to cloudy in just a single day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to add a little extra food for a midday break"?
quests.question: Pack a Snack
quests.hint: You eat this later, between breakfast and lunch or after school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing a snack means bringing a small bite for later.
quests.funFact: Fruit, crackers, and cheese are popular choices for a packed snack!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to glance left and right before stepping off the curb"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: This keeps you safe before you step into the street.
quests.explanation: That's right! Looking both ways means checking left and right before crossing safely.
quests.funFact: Crosswalks and traffic lights help keep everyone safe while crossing busy streets!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to offer a polite thank you after eating together"?
quests.question: Say Thank You for Dinner
quests.hint: A smile often goes along with these polite words.
quests.explanation: Well done! A little gratitude can make mealtime feel warm and happy.
quests.funFact: Saying thank you is a simple habit that can make the people around you feel appreciated!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to zip up something warm before you go outside"?
quests.question: Put on a Coat
quests.hint: You put this on only when the weather turns chilly.
quests.explanation: Well done! A cozy coat keeps us warm when the weather turns cold.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather first can help you know if you'll need a coat that day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to peek outside and see what the sky looks like"?
quests.question: Check the Weather
quests.hint: A window or a weather app can help with this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Knowing the weather helps us get ready for the day ahead.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather can help you decide between a raincoat or sunglasses!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to plan the exact time you'll wake up"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: You do this at night, even though it helps your morning.
quests.explanation: Well done! A helpful alarm makes sure we're not late for school.
quests.funFact: The very first alarm clocks were invented so people wouldn't oversleep for work!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to check the road carefully before crossing safely"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: You do this at a crosswalk, right before crossing.
quests.explanation: Well done! Checking both ways keeps us safe on the way to school.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing is one of the most important safety habits to learn!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to tuck a small treat into your bag for later"?
quests.question: Pack a Snack
quests.hint: Crackers, fruit, or a granola bar might be packed for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed snack helps keep your energy up during the day.
quests.funFact: A small packed snack can be just the boost you need in the middle of a busy day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to close your eyes after a long, fun day"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: You climb under soft blankets for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We go to bed at night to rest our busy bodies.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to share a grateful word once the meal is done"?
quests.question: Say Thank You for Dinner
quests.hint: This happens right after everyone finishes eating, not before.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say thank you for dinner to show we appreciate the meal.
quests.funFact: Families around the world have their own kind words to share after a meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to rest your body with a little quiet sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This sleep is shorter than your nighttime sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a nap in the afternoon to rest and recharge.
quests.funFact: A short nap can help you feel happier and more focused afterward!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to enjoy games and sunshine outdoors"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: Fresh air, sunshine, and running are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We play outside in the afternoon to enjoy fresh air and exercise.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is a great way to get exercise while having lots of fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to dim your room right before you fall asleep"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: A small switch on the wall helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We turn off the light at night to make our room cozy for sleep.
quests.funFact: A dark room can help your body understand that it's time to sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to look down the road for the bus to appear"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: You need a little patience while you do this.
quests.explanation: Well done! A little patience helps us wait safely for the bus.
quests.funFact: Bus stops often have a sign so everyone knows exactly where to wait!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to place plates and spoons before a meal"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: It helps get everyone ready to sit down and eat together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Helping set the table is a great way to help your family.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to fill your bowl with crunchy flakes and milk"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: This makes a crunchy start to your breakfast.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pouring cereal is a fast way to get breakfast ready.
quests.funFact: Cereal was first made as a quick, healthy breakfast that's easy to prepare!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to keep your clothes tidy instead of leaving them out"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: A hook or a hanger is where these end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our clothes to keep our room neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hanging up your clothes can help them stay neat and ready to wear again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to nibble on something yummy before dinner"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a full meal, just a little bite.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat a snack in the afternoon for a little extra energy.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to gather your toys and put them away neatly"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: Toy bins or shelves are where these things end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clean up our toys after playtime to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Putting toys away in the same spot each time makes them easy to find next time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to choose a shirt and pants for the day"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You pick a shirt, pants, and maybe a favorite pair of socks.
quests.explanation: Correct! We choose our clothes and get dressed every single morning.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!
